personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply refined financial sanctuary that replaces clutter with breathing room and uses elegant typography to evoke high-end exclusivity.

spacing.rule: Generous negative space is the primary indicator of luxury. Separate related items with at least 24px, and major sections with 48px or more. Avoid visual crowding at all costs.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Apply glass overlay on the hero balance card combined with the abstract texture.
Use glass on sticky section headers.
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs.
Avoid stacking more than 2 blurred surfaces on a single screen.

screens.name: Google Login
screens.purpose: A cinematic, frictionless entry point highlighting the premium nature of the app.

states.loading: Subtle elegant spinner over the hero background.
states.error: Minimalist red text notification gracefully dropping from top.

screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract luxury background image. The top 50% is visual breathing room. At the bottom 30%, a glass-morphic sheet or gradient scrim holds the elegant 'Salary Manager' serif title, followed by a wide, minimalist Google Social Login button (white bg, grey border, sleek logo).

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: The financial command center presenting balances and summaries with airy, card-based progressive disclosure.

states.loading: Skeleton lines with a soft, slow shimmer effect.
states.empty: Beautiful minimalist icon illustrating 'No data yet' with a prompt to set salary.
states.error: A calm, readable error card requesting a retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: Glass-morphic Hero Card over a subtle abstract background showing 'Available Balance' in huge Serif typography (e.g., 48px). Below it, a clean 'Salary' CTA button to trigger the modal. Middle section: 2-column grid or horizontal scrolling cards for 'Total Expenses' and 'Extra Income'. Bottom section: 'Monthly Stats' chart or simple progress bars with massive padding. Floating bottom tab bar (glass).

screens.name: Salary Modal
screens.purpose: A focused, distraction-free input to update the core financial baseline.

states.error: Shake animation on input, red subtext.

screens.layout: Opened via a centered Bottom Sheet or full-screen Modal. Dimmed background. An oversized, borderless input field in Serif font dominating the screen. A single, wide, premium sticky CTA button ('Set Salary') anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: A refined ledger of expenses and extra income, grouped logically with generous spacing.

states.empty: Elegant illustration (e.g., an empty tray or abstract shape) with 'No transactions yet'.
states.error: Minimalist error state with a reload icon.

screens.layout: Top row: Segmented control or elegant tabs (Expenses / Income). List rows: Generous vertical padding (24px per row). No ugly dividers; just negative space. Each row features a subtle icon container (`brandTertiary` background), title, and amount aligned right. Swiping a row reveals luxurious, smooth 'Edit' and 'Delete' actions. Floating Action Button (FAB) for adding new transactions.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: A comprehensive configuration area handling profile, theme switching, and account danger zones.
screens.layout: List layout with 32px gaps between logical groups. Group 1: Personal Info (Name, masked email/password). Group 2: Interface Design. Features a 3-option accent color picker displaying Midnight Navy, Champagne Gold, and Deep Emerald as premium tinted circles. A toggle for Light/Dark mode. A currency switcher (EUR, USD, GBP). Group 3: Log Out and Delete Account (red text, bottom anchored).

login_hero.alt: Abstract elegant background with subtle geometry

home_card_bg.alt: Subtle abstract texture for balance card

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THE 3 REQUIRED ACCENT COLORS. The default theme is Light Mode with Midnight Navy (#0B1F3B). You MUST implement the color picker logic in Settings that swaps 'brand', 'brandPrimary', 'brandSecondary', and 'brandTertiary' across the entire app.
THEME TOKENS FOR CHAMPAGNE GOLD: brandPrimary = #C6A45A. brandSecondary = #A48645. brandTertiary = #F9F5EC (Light Mode) / #3A301A (Dark Mode).
THEME TOKENS FOR DEEP EMERALD: brandPrimary = #0F3D2E. brandSecondary = #0A281E. brandTertiary = #E7ECEA (Light Mode) / #071D15 (Dark Mode).

DARK MODE BASE TOKENS: surface = #050505, surfaceSecondary = #121212, surfaceTertiary = #1E1E1E. In dark mode, ensure brandPrimary buttons still have visible contrast, or use a slightly lighter tint for readability.
Typography: Use Cormorant Garamond for all major numbers (balances, totals, inputs) and headers. Use Satoshi for all labels, subtext, and lists. Do not exceed font-weight 500.
Spacing: Execute 'Luxury of Air'. Pad major cards by at least 24px inside, and separate groups by 48px. Avoid dividing lines entirely; use negative space to separate list items.
Use a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (0% transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) whenever placing text over the 'login_hero' or 'home_card_bg' images.
Build the Salary Modal as a bottom sheet with a massive, focused input field. Strip away all unnecessary UI chrome.
Settings Screen: Implement the lockout timer for the 'Delete Account' button as requested in the brief (e.g., a 5-second countdown before the button becomes active).
